t: The Fortress Trade 1" Flat Paint Brush is a reliable tool for professional decorators and painters requiring precise application and efficient coverage. Its synthetic bristles and mixed filaments are engineered to deliver superb load capacity and reduce tramlines, ensuring a smooth finish across various surfaces. The solid, round tapered filaments provide excellent control, making it ideal for detailed trim work or larger wall sections. Featuring a rust-resistant stainless steel ferrule and a comfortable beavertail handle, this durable painting brush is quick and easy to clean after use, saving valuable time on site.
